text:
Ava (Docs): Heads-up — opening a docs PR to consolidate function/tool-calling guardrails and structured-output examples. Goal: one canonical JSON-schema example + small SDK snippet updates and a couple link fixes. Thread to coordinate quick reviews.

Sam (SDK): Awesome. Can you paste the current canonical example here? I can prepare Python + JS snippets aligned with the new SDK patterns.

Ava (Docs): Pasting the snippet from the draft page (we currently show the older 'tool_call' shape):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string"},
    "payload": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```

Ava (Docs): Plan is to switch wording to emphasize: 1) explicit JSON Schema for structured outputs, 2) guardrail examples for missing/extra fields, 3) parsing example that tolerates minor deviations (strip non-json prefix).

Ravi (Eng-ML): Suggest adding a short note about model output noise and a tiny robust parse snippet: `const j = JSON.parse(text.replace(/^.*?\{/, '{'))` — but add caution.

Sam (SDK): I'll prepare two snippets:
- `from redwood import Client` (py) with `client.parse_structured_output(...)` helper
- `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` (js) with `client.tools.call()` pattern.

Luis (PM): Quick ask — can we also update the cross-link from the function-calling guide to the schema examples? Right now it points to the old path `/docs/tool-calling/old-schema`. I can list exact links after PR.

Ava (Docs): Yep — I'll include a redirect note and update both links. Also planning a tiny migration note: "If you were using `tool_call` shape, switch keys `tool`->`action` and `args`->`payload` and prefer the schema-validated helper."

Sam (SDK): One question: do we preserve the legacy snippet for backwards compatibility in the SDK docs? I think keep legacy but mark deprecated. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Eng-ML): +1 keep deprecated example but collapsed under an accordion. Add a short eval example that shows regression check for structured outputs.

Ava (Docs): For reviewers: please check wording in the guardrails section — I'm adding three micro-examples: missing required field, extra unexpected fields, and partial JSON with human text preface. Shortest possible examples so readers can copy/paste.

Sam (SDK): I'll attach the updated snippets to the PR in a separate `snippets/` dir so the docs build picks them up. Also will add a one-liner to release notes.

Ava (Docs): Great. Anyone volunteer for quick link sweep after merge? I can do the docs side, need someone from SDK to update npm package snippets test.

Sam (SDK): I can run the snippet tests.

Luis (PM): I'll add this to next week's fixlist and ping legal for the telemetry blurb (if needed).

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — Ava: guardrail + schema examples + TODOs.

Ava (Docs): Thanks — ping reviewers: @Sam (SDK), @Ravi (Eng-ML) for technical review, @Luis (PM) for link/PM check. Trying to get this merged before the next release cut. :rocket:

Sam (SDK): I'll review today after standup.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Will check robustness notes and add the tiny parse snippet test.

Ava (Docs): Short checklist I'm adding to PR description:
- [ ] canonical JSON Schema included
- [ ] 2 SDK snippets (py/js) updated
- [ ] deprecation note for old shape
- [ ] cross-link fixes done
- [ ] small regression eval example added
- [ ] CI snippet tests passing

Sam (SDK): Sounds good. If anyone finds a wording nit, please push to the branch — small edits welcome.

Luis (PM): Thx all, will follow up post-merge on release blurb.

Ava (Docs): Closing here once PR merged — will post a short changelog entry in #release-war-room. :white_check_mark:
